# Clover Case

> Clover Case: Noodle Puzzle is a free iPhone packing puzzle game in the style of Kanoodle. Players rotate, flip and fit chunky ball (bead) polyomino pieces into a board. It is an independent game, not affiliated with Educational Insights.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6792343237
- 160 handcrafted levels in four difficulties (easy to expert)
- Board shapes: classic rectangle, triangle, hexagon
- Daily challenge, the same puzzle for every player, with a leaderboard
- Free with optional ads; a one-time purchase removes ads
- Works offline, no account, rated 4+
- Languages: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese
